description: Source code for a web scraper class 'QuiToque' that extracts recipe information from the 'quitoque.fr' website, including metadata, ingredients, instructions, and nutrients.

classes.name: QuiToque
classes.description: A scraper class inheriting from AbstractScraper, tailored to extract recipe data from quitoque.fr.

methods.name: _get_text
methods.description: Normalizes and extracts text from an HTML element.

methods.name: _get_time
methods.description: Extracts total or preparation time from the recipe page.

methods.name: _nutrients
methods.description: Cached property that finds the nutrients section in the HTML.

methods.name: _get_nutrient
methods.description: Retrieves specific nutrient information by name.

methods.name: canonical_url
methods.description: Gets the canonical URL of the recipe.

methods.name: keywords
methods.description: Extracts and converts product tags into keywords.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Gets the image URL of the recipe.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of nutrient information.
